text: Greenwood Avenue is a busy residential street that experiences a high volume of traffic exiting the Don Valley parkway at Don Mills. In late 2021, it was brought to my attention that vehicles frequently park in front of the driveway at 1116 Greenwood Avenue. This letter includes a recommendation to install signage that will clearly emphasize that vehicles cannot park blocking this driveway.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Greenwood Avenue, between a point 82.5 metres north of Cosburn Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further north.
